description: Imports a Windows Legacy executable may have, per DLL, with the oldest Windows that exports each function. Read by tools/check_imports.py (run by tools/build.py windows legacy): an import that is not listed fails the build.
how_to_add: Verify the function's 'Minimum supported client' in the Microsoft documentation (and for msvcrt.dll the exports of the msvcrt.dll of the floor system), then add it with min_os, used_by and confidence. confidence is 'documented' when the documentation or a real system confirms it, 'verify' when it is believed but unconfirmed (then 'note' says what to verify). Never add an entry only to silence the check: a function newer than the floor must be loaded with GetProcAddress or kept out of the executable (docs/implementation/adr/0002).
